[Docs](#docs) | [Install](#install)

## Contents
- [Install](#install)

## Install
```bash
npm install everyinc
npm run dev
```

## Overview
EveryInc coordinates recurring operational checklists, membership workflows, and billing reminders into a shared execution dashboard.

## Features
It provides schedule automation, owner handoffs, and an audit trail for recurring company operations.

# gbrain

## About
GBrain is a personal knowledge graph workbench that captures notes, memories, and relationships for reflective planning.

## Features
It provides graph search, note linking, and timeline views for understanding evolving context.

# ActiveGraph

## Overview
ActiveGraph provides a live dependency map for event pipelines and data products.

## Capabilities
It tracks producers, consumer contracts, freshness windows, and owner escalation paths for graph-shaped operations.

## Installation
```bash
pip install paperclip
```

## What it does
Paperclip clips web articles, PDFs, and notes into a traceable research queue for later synthesis.

## Architecture
It uses source attribution records, review states, and export adapters to keep collected references auditable.

# odysseus

[![build](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-passing-green.svg)](#)

A local-first research navigator that turns web pages, notes, and source references into a graph of tasks and summaries.

## How it works
Odysseus ingests references, extracts entities, and generates a prioritized exploration route for an operator.

## Quickstart
```bash
pip install -e .
python -m odysseus
```
